passages.title: 奶奶的珍珠奶茶
passages.text: Every Sunday, my grandma makes bubble {1} for the whole family. It is the most popular drink in our house. First, she cooks the black pearls with brown {2} until they are soft and sweet. Then she mixes strong black tea with fresh milk and adds the pearls. My little brother always wants more, but Grandma says, "Too much sugar is bad for your teeth." Last week, I decided to {3} her secret recipe. {4} of playing video games, I stood next to her in the kitchen and wrote down every step. The next day, I made bubble tea by myself. It tasted almost the same as Grandma's! Dad took one sip and said, "Wow, this is even better than my morning {5}."

blanks.why: bubble tea「珍珠奶茶」是固定說法，下文也說用紅茶加鮮奶。garbage（垃圾）、traffic（交通）、weather（天氣）都不能當飲料。
brown sugar「黑糖」：用黑糖煮珍珠，煮到又軟又甜。homework（功課）、noise（噪音）、traffic（交通）都不能拿來煮珍珠。
decide to learn her secret recipe「決定學她的祕方」。lend（借出）、blow（吹）、burn（燒）接 recipe 意思都不通。
instead of + V-ing「不做…，而是…」：不打電動，而是站在廚房旁邊寫下步驟。Either、Ago、Ever 都不能和 of 搭配表示「代替」。
morning coffee「早上喝的咖啡」，和奶茶一樣是飲料，才能比較好不好喝。garbage（垃圾）、noise（噪音）、homework（功課）都不能拿來和飲料比較。

passages.zh: 每個星期天，奶奶都會為全家人做珍珠奶茶，這是我們家最受歡迎的飲料。首先，她用黑糖煮珍珠，煮到又軟又甜。接著她把濃濃的紅茶和鮮奶混在一起，再加入珍珠。我弟弟總是想再多喝一點，但奶奶說：「糖吃太多對牙齒不好。」上星期，我決定學她的祕方。我沒有去打電動，而是站在廚房裡她的旁邊，把每個步驟都寫下來。隔天，我自己做了珍珠奶茶，喝起來幾乎和奶奶做的一模一樣！爸爸喝了一小口說：「哇，這比我早上喝的咖啡還好喝。」

passages.title: 咖啡渣的妙用
passages.text: My mom drinks two cups of {1} every day, but she never throws away the used coffee grounds. Instead, she dries them in the sun and puts them into small cloth bags. She puts one bag in the fridge and one in each of our shoes. "They take away bad {2}," she says. It really works! My brother's shoes do not smell like old cheese anymore. Mom also puts the grounds and used {3} leaves around the plants in our garden. She says they help the plants grow, and our tomatoes are bigger than ever. Last weekend, she even made coffee cookies with flour, sugar, and a lot of {4}. They were delicious. Mom always says, "In our house, there is no {5}. Everything can be used again."

blanks.why: a cup of coffee「一杯咖啡」，後面也說到咖啡渣 coffee grounds。garbage（垃圾）、traffic（交通）、noise（噪音）都不能用「杯」來喝。
take away bad smells「去除臭味」，下一句說哥哥的鞋子不再有臭起司味。tickets（票）、lessons（課）、seasons（季節）都不能說是 bad 而被咖啡渣吸走。
used tea leaves「泡過的茶葉」，可以放在植物旁邊當肥料。traffic（交通）、weather（天氣）、uniform（制服）都不能接 leaves 表示「…的葉子」。
做餅乾要用麵粉、糖和奶油 butter。noise（噪音）、history（歷史）、ticket（票）都不能當材料。
there is no waste「沒有浪費」，後一句說每樣東西都能再利用。weather（天氣）、history（歷史）、distance（距離）放進去意思都不通。

passages.zh: 我媽媽每天喝兩杯咖啡，但她從來不把用過的咖啡渣丟掉。她會把咖啡渣拿去曬太陽，再裝進小布袋裡。她在冰箱放一袋，我們每個人的鞋子裡也各放一袋。「它們可以去除臭味。」她說。真的有效！我哥哥的鞋子不再有放很久的起司味了。媽媽也會把咖啡渣和泡過的茶葉放在花園的植物旁邊，她說這能幫助植物生長，我們家的番茄長得比以前都大。上週末，她甚至用麵粉、糖和很多奶油做了咖啡餅乾，非常好吃。媽媽總是說：「在我們家沒有浪費這回事，每樣東西都可以再用。」

passages.title: 公園裡的檸檬汁小攤
passages.text: It was a hot summer day, so Tina and her brother Sam decided to sell lemon {1} in the park. They squeezed ten lemons and mixed the juice with cold water. Their first customer was an old man. He took one sip, and his face turned red. "It is too sour!" he shouted. Tina tasted it. He was right! She forgot to add {2}. She quickly put some in and added ice. Soon, many {3} people came to their table. Even a woman who usually drinks only {4} bought two cups. "This is better than any drink in the store," she said. By the end of the day, they {5} fifty cups. They used the money to buy ice cream for the whole family.

blanks.why: lemon juice「檸檬汁」，下一句說他們擠了十顆檸檬。garbage（垃圾）、homework（功課）、traffic（交通）都不能在公園賣給人喝。
檸檬汁太酸，是因為忘了加糖 sugar。noise（噪音）、paper（紙）、traffic（交通）都不能加進飲料讓它變甜。
thirsty people「口渴的人」，天氣熱，口渴的人才會來買飲料。wooden（木製的）、national（國家的）、plastic（塑膠的）都不能形容來買飲料的人。
drinks only coffee「只喝咖啡」，drink 後面要接飲料。garbage、noise、weather 都不能喝。
sell fifty cups「賣出五十杯」，sold 是 sell 的過去式。cried、arrived、laughed 都是不接受詞的動詞，後面不能直接接 fifty cups。

passages.zh: 那是個炎熱的夏日，所以 Tina 和弟弟 Sam 決定在公園賣檸檬汁。他們擠了十顆檸檬，把檸檬汁和冷水混在一起。第一位客人是一位老先生，他喝了一口，臉都紅了。「太酸了！」他大喊。Tina 嚐了一下，他說得沒錯！她忘了加糖。她趕快加了一些糖，又放了冰塊。很快地，許多口渴的人來到他們的攤子。就連一位平常只喝咖啡的女士也買了兩杯。「這比店裡任何飲料都好喝。」她說。到了傍晚，他們賣出了五十杯，並用賺來的錢請全家人吃冰淇淋。

passages.title: 奶油失蹤事件
passages.text: Mom wanted to {1} cookies for my class party. She needed flour, eggs, {2}, and a big piece of butter. But when she opened the fridge, the butter was not there. She looked in every corner of the kitchen, but there was no {3} anywhere. "Who took it?" she asked. Dad said no. My sister said no. Then I saw our dog, Lucky, under the table. His nose was {4} with something yellow, and he looked away when Mom called his name. "Lucky, you ate the butter!" Mom said. Lucky had a stomachache that night, poor guy. In the end, Mom used oil instead, and the cookies were still delicious. We ate them with hot milk {5}, and Lucky only got water.

blanks.why: bake cookies「烤餅乾」。marry（結婚）、pray（祈禱）、arrive（到達）都不能接 cookies 當受詞。
做餅乾的材料：麵粉、蛋、糖 sugar 和奶油。traffic（交通）、noise（噪音）、paper（紙）都不是做餅乾的材料。
前一句說冰箱裡沒有奶油，所以在廚房到處都找不到奶油 butter。museum（博物館）、uniform（制服）、government（政府）都不會放在廚房裡讓媽媽找。
be covered with「被…覆蓋、沾滿…」：狗的鼻子沾滿黃色的東西。returned、arrived、happened 都不能用「be + 過去分詞 + with」表示沾滿。
milk tea「奶茶」，配餅乾喝的飲料。garbage（垃圾）、noise（噪音）、homework（功課）都不能喝。

passages.zh: 媽媽想為我的班級派對烤餅乾。她需要麵粉、蛋、糖和一大塊奶油。但當她打開冰箱，奶油卻不見了。她找遍了廚房的每個角落，到處都沒有奶油。「是誰拿走的？」她問。爸爸說不是他，妹妹也說不是她。接著我看到我們家的狗 Lucky 在桌子底下。牠的鼻子沾滿了黃黃的東西，媽媽叫牠名字時，牠還把頭轉開。「Lucky，是你吃了奶油！」媽媽說。那天晚上 Lucky 肚子痛，真可憐。最後媽媽改用油，餅乾還是很好吃。我們配著熱奶茶吃餅乾，而 Lucky 只喝到水。

passages.title: 考試時跑了四次廁所
passages.text: Kevin had a big English test the next morning, and he felt very sleepy. So before the test, he drank a huge cup of iced {1} with lots of {2} in it. At first, he felt full of {3}. But ten minutes into the test, he needed to go to the bathroom. He raised his hand and ran out. When he came back, he needed to go again! He could not {4} on the questions at all. In the end, he went to the bathroom four times and finished only half of the test. After school, his mom laughed when she heard the story. "Coffee can wake you up, but it also sends you to the bathroom," she said. "Tomorrow, just drink a glass of orange {5} with breakfast and go to bed early tonight."

blanks.why: iced coffee「冰咖啡」，下文也說咖啡讓他一直跑廁所。weather（天氣）、garbage（垃圾）、traffic（交通）都不能用「一杯」來喝。
咖啡裡加了很多糖 sugar。paper（紙）、noise（噪音）、ticket（票）都不能加進飲料裡。
full of energy「充滿活力」，喝了咖啡一開始很有精神。weather、distance（距離）、government（政府）都不能形容人「充滿…」。
concentrate on「專心於…」：他完全無法專心看題目。borrow（借入）、invite（邀請）、collect（收集）後面不能接 on，意思也不通。
a glass of orange juice「一杯柳橙汁」，配早餐喝的飲料。homework（功課）、ticket（票）、uniform（制服）都不能喝。

passages.zh: Kevin 隔天早上有一場重要的英文考試，而他覺得很睏。所以考試前，他喝了一大杯加了很多糖的冰咖啡。一開始，他覺得精神飽滿。但考試開始十分鐘後，他就想上廁所。他舉手後衝了出去。回來之後，他又想上了！他完全無法專心看題目。最後，他跑了四次廁所，只寫完一半的考卷。放學後，媽媽聽了這件事笑了出來。「咖啡可以讓你清醒，但也會讓你一直跑廁所。」她說，「明天早餐就喝一杯柳橙汁，今晚早點睡吧。」

passages.title: 倫敦的英式下午茶
passages.text: Last summer, my family traveled to London. One afternoon, we went to a beautiful old hotel for afternoon {1}. The waiter brought us a tall plate with three levels. On it were small sandwiches, cakes, and warm scones. "In England, we eat scones with jam and {2}," the waiter told us. My little sister put so much jam on hers that some of it {3} onto her dress. Then the waiter poured hot tea into our cups. My dad asked for milk and {4}, just like a real English gentleman. We talked, laughed, and ate for two hours. Outside, it started to rain, but we did not care. It was the most {5} afternoon of our whole trip, and my sister still talks about the scones.

blanks.why: afternoon tea「下午茶」是固定說法，下文說到三層點心盤和熱茶。traffic（交通）、garbage（垃圾）、weather（天氣）都不能和 afternoon 組成去飯店享用的活動。
司康要塗果醬和奶油 butter。noise（噪音）、homework（功課）、traffic（交通）都不能塗在食物上吃。
drop onto「掉落到…上」：果醬掉到她的洋裝上。invited（邀請）、celebrated（慶祝）、believed（相信）都不能表示東西往下掉。
紅茶可以加牛奶和糖 sugar。garbage（垃圾）、paper（紙）、ticket（票）都不能加進茶裡。
the most special afternoon「最特別的一個下午」。rude（無禮的）、honest（誠實的）、patient（有耐心的）都是形容人的個性，不能形容「下午」。

passages.zh: 去年夏天，我們全家到倫敦旅行。有一天下午，我們去一間美麗的老飯店吃下午茶。服務生端來一個三層的高點心盤，上面有小三明治、蛋糕和溫熱的司康。「在英國，我們吃司康會塗果醬和奶油。」服務生告訴我們。我妹妹在她的司康上塗了太多果醬，有一些掉到了她的洋裝上。接著服務生把熱茶倒進我們的杯子。爸爸要了牛奶和糖，就像一位真正的英國紳士。我們邊聊邊笑邊吃，待了兩個小時。外面開始下雨，但我們一點也不在意。那是我們整趟旅行中最特別的一個下午，我妹妹到現在還常常提起那些司康。

passages.title: 會飛的魔法果汁
passages.text: Leo was a young student at a magic school. For his final test, he had to make a drink that could help people fly. First, he poured a glass of apple {1} into a big pot. Then he {2} in some moon water and a spoon of golden {3}. The drink began to shine like a star. To test it, Leo gave a little to his cat, Mimi. After one sip, Mimi slowly {4} into the air. "It works!" Leo shouted. But there was a problem: Mimi could not come down! She flew around the room and knocked over all the books. Leo did not know what to do. Finally, his teacher came in and gave Mimi a cup of warm {5}. "This tea makes everything heavy again," she said with a smile. Mimi landed softly, and Leo passed the test.

blanks.why: apple juice「蘋果汁」，可以倒進鍋子裡做飲料。homework（功課）、noise（噪音）、weather（天氣）都不能「倒」進鍋子，也不能和 apple 組成飲料。
mix in「把…加進去攪拌」：把月亮水和金色的糖拌進去。cheered（歡呼）、arrived（到達）、prayed（祈禱）都不能表示把材料加進鍋裡。
a spoon of sugar「一匙糖」。traffic（交通）、noise（噪音）、weather（天氣）都不能用「一匙」來計算。
rise into the air「升到空中」，rose 是 rise 的過去式；喝了會飛的飲料，貓慢慢飄起來。lent（借出）、spent（花費）、counted（數）都不能表示往上升。
a cup of warm tea「一杯溫茶」，下一句也說 This tea。garbage（垃圾）、uniform（制服）、ticket（票）都不能裝在杯子裡喝。

passages.zh: Leo 是魔法學校的年輕學生。期末考時，他必須做出一種能讓人飛起來的飲料。首先，他把一杯蘋果汁倒進大鍋子裡，接著拌入一些月亮水和一匙金色的糖。飲料開始像星星一樣發光。為了測試，Leo 讓他的貓咪咪喝了一點。才喝一口，咪咪就慢慢飄到空中。「成功了！」Leo 大叫。但問題來了：咪咪下不來！牠在房間裡飛來飛去，把書全撞倒了。Leo 不知道該怎麼辦。最後，老師走進來，給咪咪一杯溫茶。「這種茶會讓一切重新變重。」她微笑著說。咪咪輕輕地落地，Leo 也通過了考試。

passages.title: 坪林茶園一日遊
passages.text: Last Friday, our class took a trip to a tea farm in Pinglin. The farm was on a green hill, and the air was cool and {1}. A friendly farmer showed us how to {2} tea leaves. "Only take the top two leaves. They are the softest," she said. After that, we went into a small house and watched her make the leaves into tea. Then we tasted three kinds of {3}. One was green, one was yellow, and one was almost red. Some students wanted to add {4}, but the farmer shook her head. "Good tea is already sweet. Just taste it slowly," she said. My friend Jack usually drinks only {5} at home, but he bought a small box of tea leaves for his parents. "Maybe I will change my habit," he said.

blanks.why: the air was fresh「空氣很新鮮」。honest（誠實的）、polite（有禮貌的）、careless（粗心的）都是形容人的字，不能形容空氣。
pick tea leaves「採茶葉」。marry（結婚）、arrive（到達）、cry（哭）都不能接 tea leaves 當受詞。
taste three kinds of tea「品嚐三種茶」，下文說顏色有綠、黃、接近紅。garbage（垃圾）、homework（功課）、traffic（交通）都不能品嚐。
有些同學想在茶裡加糖 sugar，所以農夫說好茶本來就有甜味。paper（紙）、noise（噪音）、weather（天氣）都不能加進茶裡。
drinks only coffee「只喝咖啡」，所以後面說他可能會改變習慣。garbage、noise、homework 都不能喝。

gloss: 坪林（新北市產茶的地方）
passages.zh: 上星期五，我們班到坪林的一座茶園校外教學。茶園在一座綠色的山丘上，空氣涼爽又新鮮。一位親切的農夫教我們怎麼採茶葉。「只要摘最上面的兩片葉子，它們最嫩。」她說。之後，我們走進一間小屋，看她把茶葉做成茶。接著我們品嚐了三種茶：一種是綠色的，一種是黃色的，還有一種幾乎是紅色的。有些同學想加糖，但農夫搖搖頭說：「好茶本來就是甜的，慢慢品嚐就好。」我的朋友 Jack 在家通常只喝咖啡，但他買了一小盒茶葉給爸媽。「也許我會改變我的習慣。」他說。

passages.title: 一瓶果汁裡有多少糖
passages.text: In health class, Ms. Wang held up a bottle of orange {1} from the store. "How much sugar do you think is in this?" she asked. We guessed two or three spoons. Then she put eight spoons of {2} on the table. Everyone was {3}. "Eight spoons? But the bottle says 'one hundred percent fruit'!" said Amy. Ms. Wang explained, "Fruit has its own sugar. When you drink juice, you get all the sugar, but you lose a lot of the good parts of the fruit. Eating a whole orange is much better for your {4}." Since that day, I have stopped buying sweet drinks. Now I bring water or green {5} without sugar to school. My mom is very happy about my new habit.

blanks.why: a bottle of orange juice「一瓶柳橙汁」，後文說到果汁裡的糖。homework（功課）、ticket（票）、garbage（垃圾）都不能裝在瓶子裡賣。
eight spoons of sugar「八匙糖」，回答果汁裡有多少糖。paper（紙）、noise（噪音）、ticket（票）都不能用「匙」計算。
everyone was surprised「大家都很驚訝」，下一句 Amy 不敢相信有八匙。wooden（木製的）、empty（空的）、national（國家的）都不能形容人的感受。
be good/better for your health「對健康好」。weather（天氣）、distance（距離）、history（歷史）放進去意思都不通。
green tea without sugar「無糖綠茶」，可以帶到學校喝。garbage（垃圾）、noise（噪音）、ticket（票）都不能喝。

passages.zh: 健康課時，王老師拿起一瓶從商店買來的柳橙汁。「你們覺得這裡面有多少糖？」她問。我們猜兩、三匙。接著她在桌上放了八匙糖，大家都嚇了一跳。「八匙？可是瓶子上寫著『百分之百果汁』耶！」Amy 說。王老師解釋：「水果本身就有糖。當你喝果汁時，你得到了所有的糖，卻失去水果裡很多好的部分。吃一整顆柳橙對你的健康好多了。」從那天起，我不再買甜的飲料。現在我帶白開水或無糖綠茶到學校。媽媽對我的新習慣很滿意。

passages.title: 教師節的咖啡與花茶
passages.text: On Teacher's Day, our class wanted to {1} our teachers. We knew that Mr. Chen, our math teacher, cannot live without {2}, so we bought him a big cup from the shop near school. Ms. Lee, our English teacher, does not drink coffee, so we made her a cup of jasmine {3}. The night before, Amy and I also baked small cakes with lots of {4} and wrote "Thank You" on each one. In the morning, we {5} behind the classroom door. When the teachers walked in, we jumped out and shouted, "Happy Teacher's Day!" Mr. Chen almost dropped his books. Ms. Lee laughed and said, "This is the sweetest tea I have ever had." We all felt very proud.

blanks.why: surprise our teachers「給老師驚喜」，surprise 當動詞，後面接人。arrive（到達）、cry（哭）、pray（祈禱）都不能直接接 our teachers 當受詞。
cannot live without coffee「沒有咖啡活不下去」，所以買一大杯給他。garbage（垃圾）、traffic（交通）、weather（天氣）都不能在店裡買一杯送給老師。
jasmine tea「茉莉花茶」，李老師不喝咖啡，所以泡茶給她，最後她也說 the sweetest tea。homework、uniform、noise 都不能用「一杯」泡給人喝。
烤蛋糕要加很多奶油 butter。traffic（交通）、history（歷史）、weather（天氣）都不能當蛋糕的材料。
hide behind the door「躲在門後」，hid 是 hide 的過去式；老師進來時才跳出來。lent、sold、spent 後面都要接受詞，不能直接接 behind the door。

passages.zh: 教師節那天，我們班想給老師們一個驚喜。我們知道數學老師陳老師沒有咖啡就活不下去，所以在學校附近的店買了一大杯給他。英文老師李老師不喝咖啡，所以我們幫她泡了一杯茉莉花茶。前一天晚上，Amy 和我還烤了加很多奶油的小蛋糕，並在每個蛋糕上寫上「謝謝」。早上，我們躲在教室門後面。老師們一走進來，我們就跳出來大喊：「教師節快樂！」陳老師嚇得差點把書掉在地上。李老師笑著說：「這是我喝過最甜的茶。」我們都覺得非常驕傲。

passages.title: 早餐店阿姨的好記性
passages.text: Every morning on my way to school, I stop at the breakfast shop near my house. The owner, Auntie Mei, has an amazing memory. She never needs to write anything down. When I walk in, she always says, "Toast with {1} and a large milk {2}, right?" She remembers what every customer likes, even people who came only once. Mr. Lin, the bus driver, always gets black {3} without sugar. Little Ken from the third grade always wants apple juice. One morning, I wanted to {4} something new, so I asked for a ham sandwich. Auntie Mei looked at me in surprise. "Are you sick today?" she asked. Everyone in the shop laughed. Now she {5} that I like both!

blanks.why: toast with butter「奶油吐司」，早餐店常見的餐點。traffic（交通）、weather（天氣）、noise（噪音）都不能塗在吐司上。
a large milk tea「一杯大杯奶茶」。garbage（垃圾）、homework（功課）、ticket（票）都不能和 milk 組成飲料。
black coffee without sugar「不加糖的黑咖啡」。garbage、noise、uniform（制服）都不能喝，也不能說「不加糖」。
try something new「嘗試新的東西」，所以改點火腿三明治。marry（結婚）、arrive（到達）、cry（哭）都不能接 something new 當受詞。
remember that + 句子「記得…」：她現在記得我兩種都喜歡。arrives、happens、cries 後面都不能接 that 子句。

passages.zh: 每天早上上學途中，我都會在家附近的早餐店停下來。老闆梅姨的記性非常驚人，她從來不需要把東西寫下來。我一走進去，她總是說：「奶油吐司配大杯奶茶，對吧？」她記得每位客人喜歡吃什麼，就算是只來過一次的人也一樣。公車司機林先生總是點不加糖的黑咖啡，三年級的小 Ken 總是要蘋果汁。有一天早上，我想嘗試新東西，所以點了火腿三明治。梅姨驚訝地看著我：「你今天生病了嗎？」店裡的每個人都笑了。現在她記得我兩種都喜歡了！

passages.title: 三杯飲料的推理題
passages.text: Ms. Chang put three cups on her desk: one of hot coffee, one of hot tea, and one of cold orange juice. "These cups {1} to Mr. Wu, Ms. Lin, and Mr. Ho," she said. "Can you guess whose cup is whose? Here are the clues. Mr. Wu never drinks hot drinks in summer. Ms. Lin cannot drink {2} because it gives her a headache." The class was quiet for a minute. Then Jenny raised her hand. "Mr. Wu has the {3} because it is the only cold drink. Ms. Lin cannot have coffee, so she has the {4}. That means the coffee is Mr. Ho's." "Excellent!" said Ms. Chang. "You are a very {5} detective." Just then, Mr. Ho walked in and picked up the coffee. Jenny was right!

blanks.why: belong to「屬於」：這三杯分別屬於三位老師。arrive（到達）、happen（發生）、cry（哭）接 to 人都不能表示「屬於」。
林老師不能喝咖啡 coffee，因為會頭痛；桌上三杯之一就是咖啡。garbage（垃圾）、traffic（交通）、weather（天氣）都不能喝。
吳老師夏天不喝熱的，所以拿唯一冰的柳橙汁 juice。weather（天氣）、homework（功課）、noise（噪音）都不是桌上的飲料。
林老師不能喝咖啡，剩下的熱飲就是茶 tea。garbage、ticket（票）、uniform（制服）都不是桌上的飲料。
老師說 Excellent!，是在稱讚 Jenny 是很聰明的偵探 clever。lazy（懶惰的）、rude（無禮的）、careless（粗心的）都是批評的話，和稱讚不合。

passages.zh: 張老師在桌上放了三個杯子：一杯熱咖啡、一杯熱茶和一杯冰柳橙汁。「這三杯分別是吳老師、林老師和何老師的。」她說，「你們猜得出哪杯是誰的嗎？線索如下：吳老師夏天從不喝熱飲。林老師不能喝咖啡，因為咖啡會讓她頭痛。」全班安靜了一分鐘，接著 Jenny 舉手了：「吳老師拿的是柳橙汁，因為那是唯一的冰飲料。林老師不能喝咖啡，所以她的是茶。那咖啡就是何老師的。」「太棒了！」張老師說，「你是個非常聰明的偵探。」就在這時，何老師走進來，拿起了那杯咖啡。Jenny 猜對了！

passages.title: 運動會的最後一棒
passages.text: On Sports Day, I was the last runner in our class relay race, so I was very {1}. My hands were cold, and my heart was beating fast. Before the race, my friend Nina gave me a bottle of grape {2}. "Grape juice has natural {3}, so it will give you energy," she said. I drank half of it and felt a little better. Then I stood at the line and waited. When I got the stick, we were in third place. I ran as fast as I could and passed two runners just before the finish line. We won first place! After the race, our whole class {4} with cups of cold black {5} from our teacher. It was the best day of the school year.

blanks.why: 跑最後一棒，手冰冷、心跳很快，表示很緊張 nervous。wooden（木製的）、expensive（昂貴的）、delicious（好吃的）都不能形容人的心情。
a bottle of grape juice「一瓶葡萄汁」，下一句也說 Grape juice。homework（功課）、ticket（票）、noise（噪音）都不能裝在瓶子裡喝。
葡萄汁含有天然的糖 sugar，可以提供能量。paper（紙）、noise（噪音）、history（歷史）都不是果汁裡的成分。
celebrate「慶祝」：贏了第一名，全班一起慶祝。borrowed（借）、explained（解釋）、counted（數）後面接 with 冰紅茶，意思都不通。
cold black tea「冰紅茶」，用杯子裝著喝。garbage（垃圾）、weather（天氣）、uniform（制服）都不能喝。

passages.zh: 運動會那天，我是班上接力賽的最後一棒，所以非常緊張。我的手冰冰的，心跳得好快。比賽前，我的朋友 Nina 給我一瓶葡萄汁。「葡萄汁有天然的糖分，可以給你能量。」她說。我喝了一半，覺得好一點了。接著我站到線上等待。我接到棒子的時候，我們是第三名。我拚命地跑，就在終點線前超過了兩個人。我們拿到第一名！比賽結束後，全班用老師請的冰紅茶一起慶祝。那是這學年最棒的一天。

passages.title: 京都的抹茶體驗
passages.text: During our trip to Kyoto, my family joined a Japanese tea ceremony. We took off our shoes and sat on the floor of a quiet room. The tea master moved very {1} and carefully. She mixed green tea powder with hot water until it was full of tiny bubbles. Before drinking the {2}, we each ate a small sweet made of beans and {3}. "The sweet makes the tea taste better," she said. My little brother is not a very {4} person. He wanted to drink it right away, but Mom stopped him and gave him a look. When I finally tasted the tea, it was a little bitter but very smooth. My dad said, "Wow, it is stronger than my morning {5}!"

blanks.why: move slowly and carefully「動作緩慢又小心」，茶道的動作很講究。cheaply（便宜地）、hungrily（飢餓地）、expensively（昂貴地）都不能形容茶道老師的動作。
喝茶 tea 之前先吃一個甜點，前面說用抹茶粉加熱水。garbage（垃圾）、uniform（制服）、ticket（票）都不能喝。
用豆子和糖 sugar 做的小甜點。noise（噪音）、traffic（交通）、weather（天氣）都不能拿來做點心。
not a very patient person「不是很有耐心的人」，所以想馬上就喝。delicious（好吃的）、wooden（木製的）、crowded（擁擠的）都不能形容人的個性。
stronger than my morning coffee「比我早上喝的咖啡還濃」，和茶一樣是飲料才能比較。garbage、noise、homework 都不能喝。

passages.zh: 我們到京都旅行時，全家參加了一場日本茶道體驗。我們脫掉鞋子，坐在一間安靜房間的地板上。茶道老師的動作非常緩慢又小心。她把抹茶粉和熱水混合，攪到充滿細小的泡泡。喝茶之前，我們每人先吃了一個用豆子和糖做的小甜點。「甜點會讓茶更好喝。」她說。我弟弟不是很有耐心的人，他想馬上就喝，但被媽媽阻止了，還瞪了他一眼。當我終於嚐到那杯茶時，它有一點苦，但非常順口。爸爸說：「哇，這比我早上喝的咖啡還濃！」

passages.title: 熊先生的森林麵包店
passages.text: Mr. Bear had a small bakery in the middle of the forest. His bread was soft and smelled wonderful because he used lots of fresh {1}. Every morning, his shop was {2} with animals. Rabbit always bought carrot bread, and Fox always ordered honey toast and a cup of hot {3}. One day, Mr. Bear ran out of {4}. Without it, he could not make his sweet bread. So he went to visit the bees and {5} a big jar of honey from them. He used the honey to make a new kind of bread. It was even sweeter than before, and all the animals loved it. Now Mr. Bear gives the bees free bread every Friday to say thank you.

blanks.why: 麵包又軟又香，是因為用了很多新鮮奶油 butter。noise（噪音）、traffic（交通）、weather（天氣）都不能做麵包。
be crowded with「擠滿了…」：每天早上店裡都擠滿了動物。honest（誠實的）、polite（有禮貌的）、careless（粗心的）都不能接 with animals 形容店。
a cup of hot tea「一杯熱茶」，配蜂蜜吐司。garbage、uniform（制服）、ticket（票）都不能喝。
run out of sugar「糖用完了」，所以做不出甜麵包。noise、history（歷史）、weather 都不是做麵包用的東西。
borrow … from …「向…借…」：向蜜蜂借了一大罐蜂蜜。explained（解釋）、cheered（歡呼）、arrived（到達）都不能用「物 from 人」的句型。

passages.zh: 熊先生在森林中間開了一家小麵包店。他的麵包又軟又香，因為他用了很多新鮮奶油。每天早上，他的店裡都擠滿了動物。兔子總是買紅蘿蔔麵包，狐狸總是點蜂蜜吐司和一杯熱茶。有一天，熊先生的糖用完了，沒有糖，他就做不出甜麵包。於是他去拜訪蜜蜂，向牠們借了一大罐蜂蜜。他用蜂蜜做出一種新麵包，比以前還要甜，所有動物都很喜歡。現在熊先生每個星期五都會送蜜蜂免費的麵包來表達謝意。

passages.title: 罐子裡變出奶油
passages.text: In science class, Mr. Huang gave each group a small jar of cream. "Today, we will make {1} with our own hands," he said. We could not {2} it. "All you need to do is shake the jar," he told us. We took turns shaking it for ten minutes. My arms were so {3} that I wanted to stop. Then, suddenly, we heard a different sound. There was a soft yellow ball inside the jar! It was real butter. We spread it on crackers. Lisa added a little honey and {4} to make sweet butter. To go with our snack, Mr. Huang made a big pot of black {5}. It was the most delicious science class ever, and nobody wanted it to end.

blanks.why: make butter「做奶油」，後文說罐子裡出現黃色的球，就是真的奶油。traffic（交通）、history（歷史）、weather（天氣）都不能用手做出來。
could not believe it「不敢相信」，搖一搖就能做奶油讓人很意外。arrive（到達）、happen（發生）、cry（哭）都不能接 it 當受詞。
搖了十分鐘，手很痠很累 tired，想停下來。honest（誠實的）、national（國家的）、expensive（昂貴的）都不能形容手臂的感覺。
加蜂蜜和糖 sugar 做成甜奶油。paper（紙）、weather（天氣）、noise（噪音）都不能加進奶油裡。
a pot of black tea「一壺紅茶」，配點心喝。garbage（垃圾）、ticket（票）、noise（噪音）都不能用壺泡來喝。

passages.zh: 自然課時，黃老師給每一組一小罐鮮奶油。「今天我們要親手做奶油。」他說。我們都不敢相信。「你們只要搖這個罐子就好。」他告訴我們。我們輪流搖了十分鐘，我的手臂累到想停下來。接著，我們突然聽到不一樣的聲音，罐子裡出現一顆軟軟的黃色小球！那是真的奶油。我們把它塗在蘇打餅乾上。Lisa 加了一點蜂蜜和糖，做成甜奶油。為了搭配我們的點心，黃老師泡了一大壺紅茶。那是有史以來最好吃的一堂自然課，沒有人希望它結束。

passages.title: 被螞蟻占領的方糖城堡
passages.text: For the school art contest, Ivy decided to build a castle out of sugar cubes. She used five boxes of {1}. It took her a whole week to {2} it. The castle had four towers and a little bridge, and it looked like something from a Disney movie. But the night before the contest, her little brother spilled some apple {3} on the floor next to her desk. He did not clean it up. The next morning, Ivy opened her door and {4}, "No!" Hundreds of ants were all over her castle! Her mom made her a cup of warm {5} to calm her down. Then they carefully moved the ants outside. Ivy still took the castle to school, and she won second prize. The judges loved the story of the ants.

blanks.why: five boxes of sugar「五盒糖」，前一句說用方糖蓋城堡。traffic（交通）、weather（天氣）、noise（噪音）都不能用「盒」來計算，也不能蓋城堡。
finish it「完成它」：花了一整個星期才完成城堡。marry（結婚）、arrive（到達）、cry（哭）都不能接 it 當受詞表示完成。
apple juice「蘋果汁」，打翻在地上又甜又黏，才會引來螞蟻。homework（功課）、ticket（票）、garbage（垃圾）都不能和 apple 組成飲料。
shout「大喊」：看到螞蟻爬滿城堡，她大喊「不要！」。lent（借出）、sold（賣）、spent（花費）都不能接說的話。
a cup of warm tea「一杯溫茶」，讓她冷靜下來。garbage、uniform（制服）、ticket（票）都不能喝。

passages.zh: 為了參加學校的美術比賽，Ivy 決定用方糖蓋一座城堡。她用了五盒糖，花了整整一個星期才完成。城堡有四座塔和一座小橋，看起來就像迪士尼電影裡的東西。但比賽前一晚，她弟弟把一些蘋果汁打翻在她書桌旁的地上，而且沒有擦乾淨。隔天早上，Ivy 一打開房門就大喊：「不要！」好幾百隻螞蟻爬滿了她的城堡！媽媽泡了一杯溫茶讓她冷靜下來，接著她們小心地把螞蟻移到外面。Ivy 還是把城堡帶到學校，並且得到了第二名。評審們很喜歡螞蟻的故事。

passages.title: 外公的老茶壺
passages.text: My grandpa has an old teapot. It is even older than my dad. Every afternoon, he makes {1} in it and drinks it slowly in the yard. He never puts any {2} in his tea, because he says it hides the real taste. One day, I was playing ball in the living room, and I {3} the teapot by accident. It fell and broke into three pieces. I hid the pieces under my bed and told no one. That afternoon, Grandpa had to drink {4} from a paper cup, and he looked very unhappy. I felt terrible, and finally I could not keep the {5} anymore. I told him everything. To my surprise, he was not angry. We glued the teapot together. It does not look pretty now, but Grandpa says his tea tastes even better because the teapot has a story.

blanks.why: make tea「泡茶」，用茶壺泡。garbage（垃圾）、ticket（票）、uniform（制服）都不能用茶壺泡來喝。
外公喝茶從不加糖 sugar，他說糖會蓋住茶真正的味道。noise、weather、history 都不能加進茶裡。
hit the teapot「打到茶壺」，所以茶壺掉下來摔破。lent（借出）、spent（花費）、invited（邀請）都不能表示不小心撞到東西。
茶壺破了，外公只好用紙杯喝咖啡 coffee。garbage（垃圾）、noise（噪音）、weather（天氣）都不能喝。
keep the secret「保守祕密」：我再也藏不住祕密，把一切告訴外公。weather、traffic（交通）、history（歷史）都不能和 keep 搭配表示「藏住不說」。

passages.zh: 我外公有一個老茶壺，它甚至比我爸爸還老。每天下午，他都用它泡茶，然後在院子裡慢慢地喝。他喝茶從來不加糖，因為他說糖會蓋住茶真正的味道。有一天，我在客廳玩球，不小心打到了茶壺。它掉下來摔成三片。我把碎片藏在床底下，沒有告訴任何人。那天下午，外公只好用紙杯喝咖啡，他看起來很不開心。我覺得很難過，最後再也藏不住這個祕密，把一切都告訴了他。出乎意料，他沒有生氣。我們一起把茶壺黏好。它現在不太好看，但外公說他的茶喝起來更好喝了，因為這個茶壺有了故事。

passages.title: 遊戲裡的補血果汁
passages.text: In Tom's favorite video game, the hero drinks magic {1} to get his power back. One sip, and he can fight again. One Saturday, Tom played the game for five hours without stopping. His eyes were dry, and his back hurt. "I need magic juice!" he said. He went to the kitchen and drank three big glasses of orange juice. But nothing happened. Instead, his stomach began to {2}. His mom came in and shook her head. "Those drinks have too much {3}," she said. "And real life is not a game. You don't need juice. You need a {4}." She made him a cup of warm honey {5} and told him to go outside and play basketball. An hour later, Tom felt much better. "Maybe sunshine is the real magic," he said.

blanks.why: magic juice「魔法果汁」，下文 Tom 也說 I need magic juice! 並去喝柳橙汁。homework（功課）、traffic（交通）、weather（天氣）都不能喝。
his stomach began to hurt「他的肚子開始痛」。lend（借出）、borrow（借入）、sell（賣）都不能用來說肚子的感覺。
果汁裡有太多糖 sugar。paper（紙）、noise（噪音）、history（歷史）都不是飲料裡的成分。
need a break「需要休息一下」，break 當名詞是「休息」；玩了五小時，該休息了。history、weather、garbage 都不能和 need a 搭配表示休息。
honey tea「蜂蜜茶」，用杯子裝著喝。garbage（垃圾）、ticket（票）、uniform（制服）都不能喝。

passages.zh: 在 Tom 最喜歡的電玩裡，主角喝了魔法果汁就能恢復力量，只要一口，他就能再次戰鬥。某個星期六，Tom 連續玩了五個小時沒有停。他的眼睛很乾，背也很痛。「我需要魔法果汁！」他說。他走到廚房，喝了三大杯柳橙汁。但什麼事都沒發生，反而肚子開始痛了。媽媽走進來搖搖頭說：「那些飲料的糖太多了。而且現實生活不是遊戲，你不需要果汁，你需要的是休息。」她泡了一杯溫蜂蜜茶給他，叫他出去打籃球。一個小時後，Tom 覺得好多了。「也許陽光才是真正的魔法。」他說。

passages.title: 夜市的甘蔗汁
passages.text: At Raohe Night Market, there is a small stand that sells fresh sugarcane {1}. The owner puts long sticks of sugarcane into a machine, and sweet juice comes out the other side. My cousin Ryan from Canada had never {2} it before. "Is there any {3} in it?" he asked. The owner laughed. "No! Sugar comes from sugarcane!" Ryan took a sip, and his eyes grew big. He ordered two more cups. Next to the stand, an old man was selling winter melon {4}, so Ryan bought a cup of that, too. Then he tried stinky tofu, grilled corn, and an oyster omelet. At the end of the night, his stomach was so {5} that he could not walk fast. "Taiwan is a dangerous place for my stomach," he joked.

blanks.why: sugarcane juice「甘蔗汁」，下一句說甘蔗放進機器，甜甜的汁就流出來。homework、ticket、garbage 都不能喝。
have never tried it「從來沒嚐過」，try 有「嘗試、吃吃看」的意思。arrived（到達）、happened（發生）、cried（哭）都不能接 it 當受詞。
Is there any sugar in it?「裡面有加糖嗎？」老闆回答糖本來就是從甘蔗來的。noise（噪音）、paper（紙）、weather（天氣）都不會被問有沒有加進飲料。
winter melon tea「冬瓜茶」，台灣常見的飲料，可以買一杯。garbage、uniform（制服）、traffic（交通）都不能喝。
his stomach was full「他的肚子很飽」，吃了一整晚，飽到走不快。honest（誠實的）、polite（有禮貌的）、careless（粗心的）都不能形容肚子。

passages.zh: 在饒河夜市，有一個賣新鮮甘蔗汁的小攤子。老闆把長長的甘蔗放進機器裡，甜甜的汁就從另一邊流出來。我從加拿大來的表哥 Ryan 以前從來沒喝過。「裡面有加糖嗎？」他問。老闆笑著說：「沒有！糖就是從甘蔗來的啊！」Ryan 喝了一口，眼睛都睜大了，他又點了兩杯。攤子旁邊有位老先生在賣冬瓜茶，所以 Ryan 也買了一杯。接著他吃了臭豆腐、烤玉米和蚵仔煎。到了晚上結束時，他的肚子飽到走不快。「台灣對我的胃來說是個危險的地方。」他開玩笑地說。

passages.title: 名叫奶油和咖啡的兩隻狗
passages.text: Last month, we adopted two puppies from the animal shelter. One was light yellow, and the other was dark brown. The yellow puppy's fur was the color of {1}, so my sister named him Butter. The brown one was the color of {2}, so I named her Coffee. The two puppies are very different, but they always sleep side by side. Butter is {3}. He sleeps almost all day and only wakes up when he hears food. Coffee is very {4}. She wants to smell, touch, and explore everything in the house. Last week, she jumped onto the table and knocked over my cup of milk {5}. Then she drank it all! Now everyone in my family keeps their drinks away from her.

blanks.why: 黃色小狗的毛是奶油的顏色 butter，所以取名叫 Butter。noise（噪音）、history（歷史）、traffic（交通）都沒有顏色可以比較。
咖啡色小狗的毛是咖啡的顏色 coffee，所以取名叫 Coffee。weather（天氣）、noise、history 都沒有顏色。
Butter 幾乎整天睡覺，表示牠很懶 lazy。delicious（好吃的）、national（國家的）、expensive（昂貴的）都不能形容狗的個性。
Coffee 什麼都想聞、想碰、想探索，表示牠很好奇 curious。wooden（木製的）、cheap（便宜的）、delicious（好吃的）都不能形容個性。
a cup of milk tea「一杯奶茶」，後面說小狗把它喝光了。garbage（垃圾）、ticket（票）、uniform（制服）都不能裝在杯子裡喝。

passages.zh: 上個月，我們從動物收容所領養了兩隻小狗，一隻是淺黃色的，另一隻是深咖啡色的。黃色小狗的毛是奶油的顏色，所以我妹妹幫牠取名叫「奶油」；咖啡色那隻的毛是咖啡的顏色，所以我幫牠取名叫「咖啡」。這兩隻小狗非常不一樣，但牠們總是並排睡在一起。奶油很懶，幾乎整天都在睡覺，只有聽到食物的聲音才會醒來。咖啡則非常好奇，家裡每樣東西牠都想聞一聞、碰一碰、探索一番。上星期，牠跳上桌子，打翻我那杯奶茶，然後全部喝光了！現在我們家每個人都會把飲料放得離牠遠遠的。

passages.title: 太空站上的一杯茶
passages.text: Astronaut Lisa has lived on the space station for six months. Many simple things are {1} in space. For example, you cannot pour {2} into a cup, because water does not fall down. Instead, it turns into little balls and flies around. So Lisa drinks from special bags with a straw. It takes some time to get used to it. In the morning, she drinks orange {3} from a bag, and in the afternoon, she has a bag of hot coffee. Once, she opened a bag of {4} too quickly. Brown balls flew everywhere in the room! She had to {5} them one by one with a towel. "Life in space is exciting," she wrote in her diary, "but I miss drinking tea from a real cup."

blanks.why: 在太空中很多簡單的事都很困難 difficult，下文舉倒茶的例子。wooden（木製的）、national（國家的）、thirsty（口渴的）都不能形容「事情」。
pour tea into a cup「把茶倒進杯子」，最後一句也說想用真的杯子喝茶。garbage（垃圾）、uniform（制服）、ticket（票）都不能倒進杯子喝。
orange juice「柳橙汁」，早上用袋子喝。homework（功課）、ticket（票）、noise（噪音）都不能喝。
a bag of coffee「一袋咖啡」，打開太快，咖啡色的球飛得到處都是。weather（天氣）、history（歷史）、traffic（交通）都不能裝在袋子裡。
catch them「抓住它們」：用毛巾把咖啡球一顆一顆接住。marry（結婚）、arrive（到達）、cry（哭）都不能接 them 表示抓住。

passages.zh: 太空人 Lisa 已經在太空站住了六個月。在太空中，很多簡單的事都變得很困難。例如，你不能把茶倒進杯子裡，因為水不會往下掉，而是變成一顆顆小球到處飄。所以 Lisa 用有吸管的特殊袋子喝飲料，這需要一些時間才能習慣。早上她從袋子喝柳橙汁，下午喝一袋熱咖啡。有一次，她太快打開一袋咖啡，咖啡色的小球飛得整個房間都是！她只好拿毛巾一顆一顆把它們接住。「太空生活很刺激，」她在日記裡寫道，「但我很想念用真正的杯子喝茶。」

passages.title: 古坑咖啡農場的一週
passages.text: My uncle has a coffee farm in Gukeng, Yunlin. Last summer, I stayed there for a week. Every morning, I helped him {1} the red coffee fruits from the trees. "The coffee beans are inside these red fruits," he explained. After work, we sat under a big tree and drank iced lemon {2}. In the afternoon, my uncle cooked the dried beans in a big pan. The smell of fresh coffee {3} the whole house. He made a cup for me, but I did not like the bitter taste of black {4}. So my aunt added some milk and {5} to it. It tasted much better! I drank the whole cup. Now, whenever I smell coffee, I remember that sunny week on the farm.

blanks.why: collect the red coffee fruits「收集紅色的咖啡果實」。marry（結婚）、arrive（到達）、cry（哭）都不能接 fruits 當受詞。
iced lemon tea「冰檸檬紅茶」，工作後坐在樹下喝。garbage（垃圾）、uniform（制服）、noise（噪音）都不能喝。
fill「充滿」：咖啡的香味充滿整間屋子。arrived（到達）、happened（發生）、cried（哭）都不能接 the whole house 當受詞。
bitter taste of black coffee「黑咖啡的苦味」。history（歷史）、traffic（交通）、weather（天氣）都沒有味道可以嚐。
咖啡裡加牛奶和糖 sugar，就比較好喝。paper（紙）、ticket（票）、noise（噪音）都不能加進咖啡裡。

gloss: 古坑（雲林縣的鄉鎮，以咖啡聞名）
passages.zh: 我舅舅在雲林古坑有一座咖啡農場。去年夏天，我在那裡住了一個星期。每天早上，我幫他從樹上收集紅色的咖啡果實。「咖啡豆就在這些紅色的果實裡面。」他解釋。工作完，我們坐在大樹下喝冰檸檬紅茶。下午，舅舅用大鍋子炒曬乾的咖啡豆，新鮮咖啡的香味充滿了整間屋子。他泡了一杯給我，但我不喜歡黑咖啡的苦味。所以舅媽幫我加了一些牛奶和糖，喝起來好多了！我把一整杯都喝完了。現在每當我聞到咖啡香，就會想起在農場那個陽光燦爛的一週。

passages.title: 園遊會的飲料攤大戰
passages.text: For our school fair, our class decided to sell drinks. We made fresh lemon {1}, milk tea, and iced {2} for the teachers. But when we set up our table, we saw a problem. The class next to us was selling the same drinks for less money! We needed a better {3}. Then Jack had one. "Let's give a free cookie with every cup!" That night, Jack and his mom baked two hundred cookies with lots of {4} and chocolate chips. The next day, students lined up at our table. They loved the free cookies, and many of them came back for a second cup. By noon, there was {5} left on our table. The class next to us came over and asked for Jack's cookie recipe!

blanks.why: fresh lemon juice「新鮮檸檬汁」，是飲料攤賣的東西。homework（功課）、ticket（票）、garbage（垃圾）都不能當飲料賣。
iced coffee「冰咖啡」，賣給老師喝。weather（天氣）、noise（噪音）、history（歷史）都不能喝。
need a better idea「需要更好的點子」，下一句 Jack had one 就是想到一個點子。weather、history、traffic 都不能「想出來」。
烤餅乾要加很多奶油 butter 和巧克力豆。noise、history、traffic 都不能當餅乾的材料。
there was nothing left「什麼都不剩」，東西全賣光了。somewhere（某處）、ago（以前）、either（任一）放在 there was 後面都不通。

passages.zh: 學校園遊會時，我們班決定賣飲料。我們做了新鮮檸檬汁、奶茶，還有給老師喝的冰咖啡。但我們擺好攤位時，發現了一個問題：隔壁班賣的飲料跟我們一樣，價錢卻比較便宜！我們需要一個更好的點子。接著 Jack 想到了：「我們每賣一杯就送一塊餅乾吧！」那天晚上，Jack 和他媽媽用很多奶油和巧克力豆烤了兩百塊餅乾。隔天，學生們在我們的攤位前大排長龍，大家都很喜歡免費的餅乾，很多人還回來買第二杯。到了中午，我們桌上的東西全賣光了。隔壁班的同學還跑過來問 Jack 餅乾的食譜！

passages.title: 外號叫「奶油手」的捕手
passages.text: My baseball coach calls me "Butterfingers." In English, this means someone who often {1} things. It is true. When the ball comes to me, it slides out of my glove like soft {2} out of a hot pan. My team lost two games because of me. I felt terrible. Then my dad said, "Don't worry. Let's {3} together every evening." So every night after dinner, we went to the park and threw the ball for an hour. After each practice, I drank a big glass of cold orange {4}, and Dad drank a can of iced {5}. Two months later, I caught every ball in the final game. My coach smiled and said, "I need a new name for you!"

blanks.why: drop things「把東西弄掉」，Butterfingers 是指常常接不住、掉東西的人。marries（結婚）、arrives（到達）、prays（祈禱）都不能接 things 表示掉東西。
球從手套滑出去，就像軟軟的奶油 butter 從熱鍋裡滑開一樣。noise（噪音）、weather（天氣）、history（歷史）都不能放在鍋子裡滑動。
Let's practice together「我們一起練習吧」，下文說每晚去公園練接球。marry（結婚）、arrive（到達）、happen（發生）都不是練球的意思。
a glass of orange juice「一杯柳橙汁」。homework（功課）、ticket（票）、uniform（制服）都不能喝。
a can of iced coffee「一罐冰咖啡」。garbage（垃圾）、traffic（交通）、noise（噪音）都不能裝在罐子裡喝。

passages.zh: 我的棒球教練叫我「奶油手」。在英文裡，這是指常常把東西弄掉的人。這是真的，每次球飛向我，它都會從我的手套滑出去，就像軟軟的奶油從熱鍋裡滑開一樣。我們球隊因為我輸了兩場比賽，我覺得很難過。後來爸爸說：「別擔心，我們每天傍晚一起練習吧。」於是每天晚餐後，我們都去公園丟接球一個小時。每次練習完，我會喝一大杯冰柳橙汁，爸爸則喝一罐冰咖啡。兩個月後，我在決賽中接住了每一顆球。教練笑著說：「我得幫你取個新外號了！」

passages.title: 超商茶葉蛋的祕密
passages.text: In every convenience store in Taiwan, you can smell tea eggs. My friend Emma from France asked me, "Why are those eggs brown?" I explained that they are {1} for hours in black {2}, soy sauce, and spices. Some people also add a little {3} to make them taste sweeter. Emma was not {4} about it at first. "Tea and eggs together? That sounds strange," she said. But she bought one anyway, with a bottle of apple {5}. She peeled the egg and took a bite. "Mmm! It is salty, a little sweet, and it smells like tea," she said. The next morning, she bought three more for breakfast and shared them with me. Now she says tea eggs are her favorite Taiwanese snack.

blanks.why: be boiled「被煮」：蛋在紅茶和醬油裡煮好幾個小時。lent（借出）、invited（邀請）、counted（數）都不能表示煮東西。
用紅茶 black tea 來煮，所以叫茶葉蛋。garbage（垃圾）、uniform（制服）、ticket（票）都不能拿來煮蛋。
加一點糖 sugar 讓味道更甜。noise（噪音）、paper（紙）、history（歷史）都不能加進去煮。
be not sure about「對…不確定」，所以她說聽起來很奇怪。wooden（木製的）、cheap（便宜的）、national（國家的）都不能形容人的想法。
a bottle of apple juice「一瓶蘋果汁」，在超商一起買的飲料。homework、ticket、noise 都不能喝。

passages.zh: 在台灣每一間便利商店裡，你都可以聞到茶葉蛋的味道。我從法國來的朋友 Emma 問我：「那些蛋為什麼是咖啡色的？」我解釋說，它們是用紅茶、醬油和香料煮了好幾個小時。有些人還會加一點糖，讓味道更甜。Emma 一開始不太確定。「茶和蛋放在一起？聽起來好奇怪。」她說。但她還是買了一顆，再配上一瓶蘋果汁。她剝開蛋咬了一口：「嗯！鹹鹹的、有一點甜，還有茶香。」隔天早上，她又買了三顆當早餐，還分給我吃。現在她說茶葉蛋是她最喜歡的台灣小吃。

passages.title: 南極企鵝咖啡館
passages.text: In Antarctica, a penguin named Pip opened a small café. He sold iced {1} and frozen fruit {2}. All the penguins and seals loved his café, because everything was cold, just like home. One day, a {3} arrived on a big ship. She was a scientist from Taiwan, and she was shaking in the cold wind. "Can I have a cup of hot {4}, please?" she asked. Pip did not know what to say. He had never made a hot drink! He did not even have a {5} to heat water. So he gave her the warmest thing he had: a thick blanket and a big hug. The scientist laughed. "This is the warmest café in the world," she said.

blanks.why: iced coffee「冰咖啡」，企鵝咖啡館賣的冰飲。weather（天氣）、history（歷史）、garbage（垃圾）都不能賣給客人喝。
frozen fruit juice「冰凍果汁」。homework（功課）、uniform（制服）、traffic（交通）都不能和 fruit 組成飲料。
a visitor arrived「一位訪客到來」，下一句說她是從台灣來的科學家。garbage、weather、history 都不能搭船抵達，也不能用 She 來指。
a cup of hot tea「一杯熱茶」，她在冷風中發抖，想喝熱飲。noise（噪音）、ticket（票）、uniform（制服）都不能喝。
a machine to heat water「加熱水的機器」。weather、history、distance（距離）都不能用來加熱水。

passages.zh: 在南極洲，一隻叫 Pip 的企鵝開了一間小咖啡館。他賣冰咖啡和冰凍果汁。所有的企鵝和海豹都很喜歡他的咖啡館，因為每樣東西都是冰的，就像家一樣。有一天，一位訪客搭著大船來了。她是從台灣來的科學家，在冷風中不停發抖。「請給我一杯熱茶好嗎？」她問。Pip 不知道該說什麼，他從來沒做過熱飲！他甚至連加熱水的機器都沒有。於是他把自己最溫暖的東西給了她：一條厚毯子和一個大大的擁抱。科學家笑了：「這是世界上最溫暖的咖啡館。」她說。

passages.title: 不加糖的生日蛋糕
passages.text: Grandpa's birthday was coming, but his doctor said he must not eat too much {1}. "Can he still have a birthday cake?" I asked Mom. "Of course," she said. "Let's make a special one." Instead of sugar, we used three very ripe {2} to make the cake sweet. We also used only a little {3} and added some nuts on top. When Grandpa saw the cake, he was worried. "I can't eat this," he said. "Don't worry, Grandpa," I told him. "There is no sugar in it." He took a small bite, then a bigger one. He was so {4} that he ate two pieces. He enjoyed them with a cup of hot oolong {5}. "This is the best birthday cake I have ever had," he said.

blanks.why: must not eat too much sugar「不能吃太多糖」，所以要做不加糖的蛋糕。noise、history、traffic 都不能吃。
ripe bananas「熟透的香蕉」，用來讓蛋糕變甜。tickets（票）、uniforms（制服）、seasons（季節）都不能用 ripe 形容，也不能做蛋糕。
只用一點點奶油 butter 做蛋糕。noise（噪音）、history（歷史）、weather（天氣）都不能當蛋糕的材料。
他很滿意 satisfied，所以吃了兩塊。wooden（木製的）、crowded（擁擠的）、cheap（便宜的）都不能形容人的感受。
oolong tea「烏龍茶」，配蛋糕喝的熱飲。garbage（垃圾）、ticket（票）、homework（功課）都不能喝。

passages.zh: 爺爺的生日快到了，但醫生說他不能吃太多糖。「那他還可以吃生日蛋糕嗎？」我問媽媽。「當然可以，」她說，「我們來做一個特別的蛋糕。」我們不用糖，而是用三根熟透的香蕉讓蛋糕變甜。我們也只用了一點點奶油，並在上面加了一些堅果。爺爺看到蛋糕時很擔心：「這個我不能吃。」「別擔心，爺爺，」我告訴他，「裡面沒有糖。」他吃了一小口，接著又吃了一大口。他非常滿意，吃了兩塊，還配了一杯熱烏龍茶。「這是我吃過最好吃的生日蛋糕。」他說。

passages.title: 山上露營的早晨
passages.text: Last weekend, my family went camping on a mountain in Nantou. The next morning, it was so cold that I did not want to leave my sleeping bag. Then I smelled something wonderful. Dad was making {1} over the fire, and Mom was frying bread and eggs in {2}. My little sister and I each got a cup of hot milk {3}. We sat outside our tent with our warm drinks and looked down. Below us was a sea of white clouds, and the sun was coming up behind it. It was a {4} sight. I {5} the cold and my sleepy eyes. Dad took a photo of us with the clouds behind. It is still on the wall in our living room.

blanks.why: make coffee over the fire「在火上煮咖啡」。garbage（垃圾）、history（歷史）、traffic（交通）都不能在火上煮來喝。
fry bread and eggs in butter「用奶油煎麵包和蛋」。noise（噪音）、weather（天氣）、history（歷史）都不能拿來煎東西。
a cup of hot milk tea「一杯熱奶茶」。ticket（票）、uniform（制服）、garbage（垃圾）都不能喝。
a wonderful sight「美妙的景色」，雲海和日出非常漂亮。lazy（懶惰的）、rude（無禮的）、thirsty（口渴的）都不能形容景色。
forget the cold「忘了寒冷」，forgot 是 forget 的過去式；美景讓人忘了冷。arrived、cried、happened 都不能接 the cold 當受詞。

passages.zh: 上週末，我們全家到南投的山上露營。隔天早上冷到我不想離開睡袋。接著我聞到了很棒的味道：爸爸正在火上煮咖啡，媽媽用奶油煎麵包和蛋。我和妹妹各拿到一杯熱奶茶。我們捧著溫暖的飲料坐在帳篷外往下看，下面是一片白色的雲海，太陽正從雲海後面升起。那是一幅美妙的景色，我忘了寒冷，也忘了想睡的眼睛。爸爸以雲海為背景幫我們拍了一張照片，那張照片到現在還掛在我們家客廳的牆上。

passages.title: 停電夜的燭光茶會
passages.text: Last night, a strong typhoon hit Taiwan, and the {1} went out at eight o'clock. We could not watch TV or use the Internet. At first, my brother and I were bored. Then Mom lit some candles, and Dad boiled water on the gas stove to make {2}. Grandma brought out a box of cookies made with {3}. My little brother wanted cold apple {4}, but Mom told him not to open the fridge, because the food inside needed to stay cold. So he drank tea with us. We sat around the candles and told stories. Grandpa told us about typhoons when he was a boy. I {5} that our family had not talked like this for a long time. When the lights came back on, nobody wanted to stop.

blanks.why: the power went out「停電了」，所以不能看電視、上網。weather（天氣）、history（歷史）、garbage（垃圾）接 went out 都不能表示停電。
爸爸用瓦斯爐燒水泡茶 tea，下文也說弟弟最後跟大家一起喝茶。noise（噪音）、ticket（票）、uniform（制服）都不能用水泡來喝。
cookies made with butter「用奶油做的餅乾」。traffic（交通）、history、weather 都不能做餅乾。
cold apple juice「冰蘋果汁」，要從冰箱拿，所以媽媽叫他不要開冰箱。homework、ticket、noise 都不能放在冰箱裡喝。
realize that + 句子「了解到、意識到…」：我發現全家很久沒這樣聊天了。arrived、cried、happened 都不能接 that 子句。

passages.zh: 昨晚，一個強烈颱風侵襲台灣，八點的時候停電了。我們不能看電視，也不能上網。一開始，我和弟弟覺得很無聊。後來媽媽點了幾根蠟燭，爸爸用瓦斯爐燒水泡茶，奶奶拿出一盒用奶油做的餅乾。我弟弟想喝冰蘋果汁，但媽媽叫他不要開冰箱，因為裡面的食物需要保持冰涼。所以他就跟我們一起喝茶。我們圍著蠟燭坐著說故事，爺爺跟我們講他小時候遇到颱風的事。我意識到我們家已經很久沒有這樣聊天了。電燈恢復時，大家都不想停下來。
